title: RRESP SLVERR Incorrectly Returned for Valid Read
description: All read responses carry RRESP=2'b10 (SLVERR) regardless of whether the address is valid, causing the master to abort all read transactions.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SBD_MISMATCH] Expected RRESP=OKAY (0), Got SLVERR (2) for valid address 0x0100
expected_root_cause: The RRESP mux has its inputs swapped; SLVERR is wired where OKAY should be [19].
failure_log:
ADDR=0x0100 (valid, mapped to S0). RRESP=2'b10.
Master aborted transaction.
UVM_ERROR: Unexpected SLVERR.
success_log: RRESP=2'b00 for valid addresses; 2'b10 only for unmapped addresses.
